[10:02:11] Microphone: Thanks for making the time today. Before we start, is it all right if I record this call for our notes?

[10:02:28] System audio: Yes, that is fine, go ahead and record.

[10:02:52] Microphone: Great. Could you walk me through the last time someone came to your front desk and had to wait?

[10:03:23] System audio: Sure. Last Tuesday we had a man come in around four in the afternoon holding his arm. The waiting room was already full, maybe twenty people.

[10:04:01] Microphone: What happened when he reached the desk?

[10:04:23] System audio: I took his name and asked what brought him in. He said he fell off a ladder. I wrote that down and told him to sit.
